{{Quote|Armor Commander.''"<br />"''Are the juggernauts ready?''"<br />"''They are.''"<br />"''Deploy juggernauts.|An Armor Commander and [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
'''Armor Commander''' was a title used by the [[Empire of the Hand]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="CrisisD">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> a [[Unidentified Armor Commander|non-Human]] held the title. They deployed nine [[Tank/Legends|juggernaut]] [[Tank/Legends|tanks]] during a [[Attack on the Red City|battle]] between Imperial forces and [[Storm-hair]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s forces on the<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Quethold system/Legends|Quethold system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
An Armor Commander's voice appeared in the novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published in [[2011]] as part of the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of the [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
